_readme: This is the weekly bundle from VIGIL, an Android app that runs a weekly plan.json written by a planner AI and records what happened. It never plans or judges: it only executes the plan and picks between options the plan wrote in advance. THE PARTS. format, exported_at, app_version: this file. schema_version: the plan.json version to write next. timezone: the phone's zone (every ts is local time with offset). period: what is covered (since null = whole log). plan_status: complete (expired), running or none. plan: the plan.json that ran. stepped_down: directives switched to variants.easier by adapt.step_down_after_hard. settings: app settings. summary: outcome counts per directive, not a judgement. ratings: EASY, OK or HARD after a completion (skipped = not answered; variant easier = the easier version ran). check_ins: the morning check-in after a bad or minimum day (answer better, same, worse or none = not answered; mode = the day's mode after it). event_types: what each event means. events: everything in time order; takeover_id groups one takeover. Test fires (trigger adhan_test or debug) are try-outs: ignore them, as summary, ratings and check_ins do. summary also leaves out the app's own directives (ids starting with vigil-). WHAT MATTERS. Ratings and check-ins are the main signal for next week's plan. Bad days, minimum days and check-ins are never failures: the user was honest about a hard day. Read them with compassion; never add load to make up for them. Write next week's plan.json from this bundle and vision.md as HANDOFF.md (VIGIL repository) describes.

plan._readme: This is a VIGIL plan: one week of directives for the VIGIL Android app, written by a planner (an AI chat) and imported by the user. The app only executes it. It never decides anything on its own: when a trigger happens (a time of day, the adhan app announcing a prayer, or too much scrolling) it takes over the phone with the steps below until they are done, and it only switches between options written here in advance. Planner: output ONE JSON object in this shape that validates against spec/schema.json: schema_version 2, week_of (the Monday, YYYY-MM-DD), expires (local time, no timezone), day_boundary, 8-14 directives across tiers 1-3, bad_day.keep (the essentials), minimum.keep (the bare essentials), after_bad_day (what the morning check-in picks after a hard day) and a small fallback_plan. Use rating to choose which directives ask EASY / OK / HARD, and give a directive that may be too much this week a variants.easier with adapt.step_down_after_hard. Read last week's bundle first (vigil-week-<week_of>.json: the ratings and check-ins matter most) and adjust; keep ids stable week to week. Keys starting with '_' are comments and are ignored. Output only the JSON.
plan.context: Week two of cutting short-form video (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts). Last week Fajr was missed mostly after late nights, so this week protects Fajr by protecting sleep: phone on charge across the room at 23:00. Weekday mornings start with one phone-free study block. The morning routine was abandoned twice last week, so it keeps its four steps but steps down to a two-step version after two HARD ratings in a row. Scrolling is not banned; it just has to be a choice, so it costs a short pause.

directives.title: FAJR

steps.text: Sit up. Feet on the floor.
Lights on. Drink a glass of water.
Make wudu.
Pray Fajr. The two sunnah first if you can.

directives.why: The day starts here. Get up for it.

directives.title: DHUHR

steps.text: Save what you're doing and stand up.
Make wudu.
Pray Dhuhr.

directives.why: Pause the work. Come back to what matters most.

directives.title: ASR

steps.text: Stop here. It will still be there in ten minutes.
Make wudu.
Pray Asr.

directives.why: Don't let the afternoon slip past it.

directives.title: MAGHRIB

steps.text: Put down what you're holding.
Make wudu.
Pray Maghrib.

directives.why: Maghrib's window is short. Go now.

steps.text: Stop scrolling, watching or working.
Make wudu.
Pray Isha, then witr.

directives.title: MORNING

steps.text: Open the curtains.
Make your bed.
Drink a full glass of water.
Write down today's top three. Paper, not the phone.

directives.why: A made bed and three clear tasks. That's a real start.

steps.text: Open the curtains.
Drink a full glass of water.

directives.title: STUDY BLOCK

steps.text: Turn on Do Not Disturb and put the phone face down, out of reach.
Close every tab you don't need for this.
Write the one thing this block is for.
Start. 50 minutes, then a 10-minute break away from screens.

directives.why: Your best hours go to your work, not to the feed.

steps.text: Drink a full glass of water.
Drink a full glass of water.

directives.title: PAUSE

steps.text: Six opens in half an hour. Put the phone down for a moment.
Take three slow breaths.
Say out loud what you actually came here to do.

directives.why: You can open it again. Just make it a choice.

directives.title: ENOUGH FOR NOW

steps.text: Close the app.
Stand up and go to another room.
Drink some water.
Look out of a window or step outside for two minutes.
Pick one real thing to do next, and do it.

directives.why: Twenty minutes is plenty. The rest of the day is still yours.

directives.title: SLEEP

steps.text: Put the phone on charge across the room.
Brush your teeth.
Make wudu.
Set out tomorrow's clothes.
Lights off. The phone stays there until Fajr.

directives.why: Fajr is won the night before.

directives.title: PLAN NEXT WEEK

steps.text: Export the weekly bundle (VIGIL › PLAN › EXPORT BUNDLE).
Open the planning chat and share the bundle.
Say honestly what worked and what didn't.
Import next week's plan before you sleep.

directives.why: Twenty minutes tonight sets up the whole week.

bad_day._note: On a rough day only the prayers, sleep and one glass of water. Everything else can wait.

minimum._note: Only if the morning after a hard day is worse still: Fajr and sleep, nothing else.

after_bad_day._note: The morning check-in after a bad day. Better: back to the full plan. Same: another bad day. Worse: a minimum day.

fallback_plan._note: Runs only if this plan expires before a new one is imported. Kept minimal on purpose.

directives.title: FAJR

steps.text: Sit up. Feet on the floor.
Make wudu.
Pray Fajr.

directives.why: The day starts here. Get up for it.

steps.text: Drink a full glass of water.

directives.title: NEW PLAN

steps.text: Export the weekly bundle, open the planning chat and make this week's plan.

directives.why: Last week's plan has run out. A new one takes twenty minutes.

directives.title: SLEEP

steps.text: Put the phone on charge across the room.
Lights off.

directives.why: Fajr is won the night before.

event_types.plan_imported: A plan was imported and became active (detail: week_of and generated_by).
event_types.plan_import_failed: An import was rejected; the previous plan stayed active (detail: the first error).
event_types.plan_expired: The plan's expires time passed; the app now runs its fallback_plan or, without one, the built-in minimal plan (detail says which).
event_types.directive_fired: A trigger happened and a takeover opened (trigger, scheduled_for, silent, steps_total; variant "easier" after a step-down). If another takeover was on screen, this one waited for it to close.
event_types.step_completed: A checklist step was ticked (step_index from 0, step_text, duration_s since the step appeared).
event_types.directive_completed: Every step was ticked (duration_s since it fired).
event_types.directive_dismissed: Closed early by holding the dismiss button for about 10 seconds (steps_done of steps_total, duration_s since it fired).
event_types.directive_timed_out: Still open 90 minutes after it fired, so it closed itself (steps_done of steps_total).
event_types.bypassed_bad_day: Closed while showing or waiting because the day became a bad day (the user switched on "I'm not okay today", or the morning check-in chose bad_day) and it is not in bad_day.keep. Not a failure.
event_types.skipped_bad_day: Not shown because it was a bad day ("I'm not okay today", or bad_day chosen by the morning check-in or by its "same" answer while it was unanswered) and it is not in bad_day.keep. Not a failure.
event_types.queued_quiet: Triggered during quiet mode (quiet: queue): held, and fired when quiet mode ends.
event_types.skipped_quiet: Not shown because quiet mode was on (quiet: ignore).
event_types.missed: A time trigger's moment passed more than 30 minutes before the app could act (phone off or asleep), so it was not shown late (scheduled_for is the planned moment).
event_types.dropped: A takeover (showing or waiting) closed without a result, with the reason in detail: its directive is no longer in the running plan (after a new import or the switch to the fallback plan), quiet mode was switched on while it waited (quiet: queue or ignore), or the developer kill switch was used.
event_types.repeated: The directive fired again while it was already showing or waiting, so it was not opened a second time.
event_types.quiet_off: Quiet mode switched off; directives held by it fire now.
event_types.bad_day_on: "I'm not okay today" switched on; it lasts until the day boundary (detail).
event_types.bad_day_off: The user tapped "I'm okay again": a bad day or a minimum day ended early and everything fires again. A day that ends by itself at the day boundary is day_mode instead.
event_types.day_mode: The day's mode changed by itself at the day boundary (mode). Detail: the day ended, so the next day is normal; or the morning check-in is due after a bad or minimum day, and until it is answered its "same" answer applies.
event_types.check_in: The morning check-in after a bad or minimum day. Answered: answer better, same or worse, and mode is what the plan's after_bad_day chose for that answer. Not answered: answer "none" and mode is the day's mode then. Detail: not answered that day, dismissed or timed out (the "same" mode stayed); or replaced by "I'm not okay today" (then a bad day, see bad_day_on, unless it already was a bad or minimum day). Its takeover is logged as directive_fired for "vigil-check-in" with trigger "check_in". Never a failure.
event_types.skipped_minimum: Not shown because it was a minimum day (chosen by the morning check-in, or by its "same" answer while it was unanswered) and it is not in minimum.keep. Not a failure.
event_types.bypassed_minimum: Closed while showing or waiting because the morning check-in chose a minimum day and it is not in minimum.keep. Not a failure.
event_types.rated: After completing it the user tapped EASY, OK or HARD (rating; variant is "easier" if the easier version ran). When it is asked follows the directive's rating field.
event_types.rating_skipped: The difficulty question (EASY / OK / HARD) was asked after a completion but not answered (detail: skipped by the user, not answered within 30 minutes, or replaced by the next one).
event_types.stepped_down: adapt.step_down_after_hard was reached (that many HARD ratings in a row), so variants.easier runs for the rest of this plan. The app never steps back up; only a new plan does.
event_types.bundle_exported: The user exported the weekly bundle.
